about: Graph spec §3 and editor spec §27, format_version_named (risk ARCH-4): a block may name the format it is written in on its graph line, as '· format 1'. A reader reads a block in its own major format or an older one, and a block that names none. It refuses a newer major plainly, with GN106, and the note's text is kept as written. One table for both readers: format-version.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_format_version.py.

a block in a newer minor of this format
